headline: Flash Comics #1 Faces $200K Drop Due To Restoration
post:
Hey fellow DC fans, a historic piece of comic book history is hitting the auction block this week, according to ComicBook.com. A rare copy of 1940's Flash Comics #1, which famously introduced the Scarlet Speedster alongside Hawkman and Johnny Thunder, is currently drawing bids. ⚡

While an unrestored 8.0 grade copy of the issue can command an incredible $234,000 according to Heritage Auctions, this particular issue received extensive restoration. Because comic grading considers restoration to be cheating the grade, this copy is sitting at a mere fraction of that value with bids just shy of $27k.

Despite the massive price difference caused by the restoration work, this foundational DC book remains an absolute cornerstone of the Golden Age. Who is your favorite Golden Age DC hero?

#FlashComics #DCComics #GoldenAge
original_title: This Golden Age Flash First Appearance Could Be Worth $234,000, But There’s a Catch

headline: Marvel Comics features six evil variants
post:
Some of Marvel's most famous heroes have crossed moral lines across decades of storytelling, according to Screen Rant. The publication notes that Marvel Comics features six notable evil variants, ranging from a cosmically corrupted Jean Grey to loss-driven alternate Reed Richards.

Among these chilling figures is The Maker, an alternate Reed Richards from the Ultimate Universe whose dark descent begins after an accident involving the Ultimatum Wave. Another striking example is Hydra's Captain America, raised in an alternate timeline and engineered by Madame Hydra to infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D. and the United States.

Other infamous variants include a profit-driven Superior Iron Man infected by an inversion spell, flesh-eating heroes in the Marvel Zombiverse, the ruthless future Hulk known as Maestro, and the devastating Dark Phoenix. Each of these characters inspires dread on the same level as their heroic counterparts.

Which of these dark comic variants is your absolute favorite? 💀🔥

#MarvelComics #Superheroes #ComicBooks
original_title: 6 Best Evil Versions Of Classic Marvel Heroes
